newsitem.title: USA: Orphan Medical files new drug application.
newsitem.headline: Orphan Medical files new drug application.

text.p: Orphan Medical Inc said Monday it had submitted an application to the Food and Drug Administration for a drug to treat ethylene glycol poisoning.
Orphan Medical said its drug Antizol prevents the body from metabolizing ethylene glycol, the main component in antifreeze.
Ethylene glycol was responsible for 32 deaths and nearly 4,800 poisonings in 1994, according to the American Association of Poison Control Centers.
Orphan Medical develops medical products for inadequately treated or uncommon diseases.
